description: An enigmatic ancient possession sigil: an incomplete thin circle broken in three unequal places, enclosing one small hollow inverted diamond and a tiny pale point. Quiet forbidden magic, restrained and mysterious, abstract rather than a familiar religious symbol. Single flat pixel-art game UI glyph on transparent background. Readable at 18 pixels, broad clean pixel strokes, minimal detail, at most 3 colors: dark ink outline, muted bone ivory body, one tiny desaturated violet accent. No object, no medallion, no metallic frame, no raised surface, no coin, no round badge background, no shadow, no flame, no sparkle cluster, no letters, no text. Whole glyph centered with generous transparent margin on every side.
